# sample-markdown

Render **Markdown** on [Div](https://github.com/build-with-div/div) exactly as
Chromium renders it. This page mixes the common README elements.

## Install

```sh
cargo add divui
```

## Features

- GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, ~~strikethrough~~
- Light and dark themes from `github-markdown-css`
- [x] Headings and paragraphs
- [ ] Syntax highlighting

| Package | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `react-markdown` | Markdown to elements |
| `github-markdown-css` | GitHub's look |

> **Note**
> Div has no webview and no JavaScript.

---

1. Parse
2. Render
3. Compare

examples.html:
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Counts words.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Counter<'a> {
    words: HashMap<&'a str, usize>,
}

impl<'a> Counter<'a> {
    pub fn add(&mut self, text: &'a str) -> usize {
        for word in text.split_whitespace() {
            *self.words.entry(word).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
        let total: usize = self.words.values().sum();
        println!("{total} words, {} unique", self.words.len());
        total
    }
}

const LIMIT: u32 = 0xff_u32 + 1_000;
static GREETING: &str = r#"raw "string""#;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut counter = Counter::default();
    counter.add("a b a");
    let c = 'x'; // char
    /* block
       comment */
    match c { 'a'..='z' => {}, _ => unreachable!() }
    Ok(())
}

examples.markdown:
```shellscript
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

NAME="${1:-world}"
files=( *.md )

greet() {
  local who=$1
  echo "Hello, $who! You have ${#files[@]} files."
}

if [[ -z "$NAME" ]]; then
  exit 1
fi

for f in "${files[@]}"; do
  wc -l "$f" | awk '{ print $1 }'
done

cat <<EOF > out.txt
name: $NAME
EOF
greet "$NAME" && echo $((2 + 3)) # comment
```

examples.html:
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

export default class Store extends Map {
  #secret = 42;
  static from(entries) { return new Store(entries); }
  get size() { return super.size; }
}

const re = /^(?<key>[a-z]+)=(\d+)$/gi;
const greet = (name = "you") => `Hello, ${name.toUpperCase()}!`;

async function main() {
  const text = await readFile("a.txt", "utf8");
  for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
    if (re.test(line)) console.log(greet(line), 1e3, 0x1f, null, undefined, true);
  }
  // done
  /** @param {number} n */
  return { ok: true, items: [1, 2, 3].map((n) => n ** 2) };
}

interface User<T extends object = {}> {
  readonly id: number;
  name?: string;
  meta: T;
}

type Pick2<T, K extends keyof T> = { [P in K]: T[P] };

enum Color { Red = "red", Green = "green" }

@sealed
class Service<T> implements Disposable {
  private cache = new Map<string, T>();
  constructor(private readonly url: string) {}
  async get(id: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
    return this.cache.get(id) as T;
  }
  [Symbol.dispose](): void {}
}

export const users: User[] = [];
let x = <const>["a", "b"] satisfies readonly string[];

```python
from __future__ import annotations
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Point:
    """A point."""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = field(default=0.0)

    def norm(self) -> float:
        return (self.x ** 2 + self.y ** 2) ** 0.5


async def main(*args, **kwargs) -> None:
    p = Point(3, 4)
    print(f"{p!r} has norm {p.norm():.2f}")  # comment
    pattern = re.compile(r"^\d+$")
    data = {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if v is not None}
    lam = lambda n: n + 1
    return None
```
